catalog.qualification_scope: Locked RPython 7.3.17 source plus official PyPy bootstrap and offline libffi/pkgconf inputs. A minimal AILH bytecode interpreter is freshly translated to both a native non-JIT VM and a generated tracing-JIT VM. Five legal inputs including n=1000000 and seven invalid inputs agree across ordinary interpretation/native/JIT. The target optimized loop contains guards, a nonempty native machine-code address range and matching positive machine-code entry counter; native target-loop counter and compiled-loop summary are recorded. Complete PyPy interpreter build, full upstream suite, GUI, benchmark and dataset qualification are not claimed.
